components.name: dataset_acquisition_and_preparation
components.notes: Acquisition scripts and cohort prep pipelines in src/drdg/data/preparation mirror legacy total_*.py and acquisition scripts.

components.name: metadata_harmonization
components.notes: Standard columns (image_id, diagnosis, dataset, patient_id, side) harmonized identically across 6 cohorts.

components.name: patient_parsing
components.notes: Exact match across 10/11 benchmark patterns. Discrepancy on APTOS when file extensions (.png) are passed in raw image_id (drdg strips extension, golden preserved it).

components.name: patient_level_splitting
components.notes: GroupShuffleSplit(train_size=0.85, random_state=42+k) on patient_id guarantees zero patient leakage between train and validation.

components.name: lodo_fold_construction
components.notes: Exact 6-cohort leave-one-dataset-out order: APTOS, DDR, DeepDRiD, IDRiD, Messidor-2, EyePACS.

components.name: image_preprocessing
components.notes: crop_fundus_roi (tolerance=7) and apply_green_channel_ablation (ben_graham_green, clahe_green, raw_green) verified byte-for-byte identical via test_preprocessing_parity.py.

components.name: retinal_fov_segmentation
components.notes: Otsu + morphological cleaning algorithm is preserved, but output dtype differs (golden returned uint8 in {0, 255}, drdg returns bool in {0, 1}), altering mean fov_ratio threshold scale.

components.name: sliding_window_mil_patch_extraction
components.notes: compute_valid_anchors and extract_mil_patches_sliding verified identical on evaluation grids via test_patch_parity.py.

components.name: augmentations
components.notes: Albumentations transforms sequence matches (HorizontalFlip, VerticalFlip, RandomRotate90, ShiftScaleRotate, ColorJitter, Normalize with ImageNet mean/std).

components.name: datasets_and_collate_logic
components.notes: FundusDualBranchDataset returns dict with global, patches, patch_mask, and label. Collate function pads patch tensors to max_patches with boolean mask.

components.name: global_context_branch
components.notes: ResNet-50 / EfficientNet backbone with CBAM attention module and adaptive average pooling produces identical feature vectors.

components.name: local_mil_branch
components.notes: Gated attention pooling (Ilse et al.) over patch representations correctly computes attention weights and aggregated bag vector.

components.name: feature_fusion
components.notes: Concatenation of global (512-d) and local (512-d) features followed by Linear(1024, 512) projection, LayerNorm, and ReLU.

components.name: softmax_ce_head
components.notes: Linear projection to 5 logits with CrossEntropyLoss and optional inverse-frequency class weights.

components.name: softmax_qwk_head
components.notes: Hybrid Cross-Entropy + Continuous QWK loss with linear lambda warmup schedule.

components.name: coral
components.notes: Shared Linear(in_features, 1, bias=False) with independent learnable biases b_k initialized via linspace(2.0, -2.0, 4). Verified via test_ordinal_parity.py.

components.name: corn
components.notes: Conditional transition probability modeling with cumprod cumulative probabilities and conditional subset masking. Verified via test_ordinal_parity.py.

components.name: clm_qwk
components.notes: Champion head: scalar severity z = w^T x, strictly increasing softplus cutpoints b_k = b_{k-1} + softplus(delta_k) + 1e-4, clog-log link, interval differencing, and hybrid loss.

components.name: continuous_qwk_loss
components.notes: Continuous quadratic-weighted kappa loss with quadratic penalty matrix W_ij = (i-j)^2 / 16. Verified via test_weight_transfer_parity.py.

components.name: training_loop
components.notes: Full epoch train/eval loops with gradient accumulation, AMP autocast, GradScaler, and metric tracking.

components.name: optimizer_construction
components.notes: AdamW is used in both, but drdg defaults to separate_decay=True (exempting 1D biases/norms from decay) and weight_decay=1e-2, whereas golden applied uniform decay=1e-4.

components.name: learning_rate_scheduling
components.notes: CosineAnnealingLR with T_max=epochs and eta_min=1e-6 stepping at epoch boundaries.

components.name: amp_behavior
components.notes: torch.cuda.amp.autocast and GradScaler with torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=use_amp).

components.name: loss_weighting_and_warmup
components.notes: Linear epoch-based warmup of lambda_qwk from 0.0 to target (0.7) over warmup_epochs (5 epochs).

components.name: early_stopping
components.notes: Monitors in-domain validation QWK with mode='max', min_delta=0.0, patience=7, saving best model state.

components.name: checkpoint_selection_resume
components.notes: Stores state_dict, optimizer_state_dict, epoch, best_val_qwk, and configuration.

components.name: v0_v1_v2_v3_model_variants
components.notes: V0: Global CNN only. V1: Local MIL only. V2: Dual-branch vanilla fusion. V3: Dual-branch + CBAM + Gated MIL (Champion).

components.name: six_fold_lodo_experiment
components.notes: Executes 6 folds with zero target cohort data leakage into source training or source validation.

components.name: five_head_ablation_experiment
components.notes: Supports Softmax_CE, Softmax_QWK, CORAL, CORN, and CLM_QWK heads under identical backbone and preprocessing.

components.name: evaluation_metrics
components.notes: Computes QWK (sklearn cohen_kappa_score with weights='quadratic'), Accuracy, per-grade Sensitivity/Specificity, and Within-1 Accuracy.

components.name: rdr_threshold_calibration
components.notes: Calibrates screening threshold tau* strictly on source validation ROC (targeting >=95% specificity) and freezes tau* for target evaluation. Verified via test_rdr_parity.py.

components.name: result_serialization
components.notes: Exports fold metrics and evaluation summaries to JSON and CSV. Schema naming is standardized.

components.name: grad_cam
components.notes: Target layer gradient-weighted activation mapping implemented with forward/backward hooks.

components.name: mil_saliency
components.notes: Splats MIL attention weights to patch coordinates with overlapping area normalization.

components.name: idrid_xai_evaluation
components.notes: Pointing Game and Area-Matched Saliency Recall against IDRiD pixel lesion masks.
